replays.question: What is his role at NeoBotiQc?

event.text: Steve is Principal Architect at NeoBotiQc inc. in Montreal, a position he held from February 2025 to September 2026 [1]. In this role, he designed and deployed generative AI applications, services, and agents with RAG options for business process automation, managing the complete delivery cycle from business requirements gathering through incremental deployment on Azure and AWS using CI/CD pipelines [1]. He also architected a multi-cloud platform for agent creation across Azure, AWS, and GCP with GitHub Actions pipelines [1].

replays.question: What experience does he have with generative AI?

event.text: Steve has been working with generative AI since 2022, focusing on integrating generative AI into business process automation through LLM-based agents and RAG systems [1]. His expertise includes designing and deploying generative AI applications and agents with optional RAG capabilities for business automation, as well as prompt engineering and creating AI skills and plugins [2]. At NeoBotiQc, he architected and deployed generative AI agents and services for intelligent hyperautomation, managing the complete delivery cycle from business requirements to incremental deployment on cloud platforms [4].

replays.question: Which cloud technologies does he know well?

event.text: Steve has extensive experience with Azure, AWS, and GCP [1], along with Salesforce and its Net Zero Cloud offering [1]. He has also worked with Docker and GitHub Actions for containerization and CI/CD pipelines [1]. His cloud expertise spans from architecture and deployment to multi-cloud infrastructure management, demonstrated through his work at Solutions Will with Azure DevOps and Salesforce instances [3], and at NeoBotiQc with multi-cloud deployments across Azure, AWS, and GCP using GitHub Actions [4].

replays.question:
AI Solutions Architect (full-time, Toronto, hybrid)
Our team builds generative assistants for financial services clients.
Responsibilities: design RAG solution architectures on AWS, lead a team of developers,
set up continuous evaluation and LLM guardrails, support clients from pre-sales to production.
Requirements: 10 years of software architecture experience, strong AWS and Python skills,
background in process automation (RPA), fluent English and French.

event.text: Steve's profile aligns well with three key requirements for this role. He has nearly 30 years of software development experience and has architected RAG solutions with LLM agents for business process automation since 2022 [1]. He demonstrates strong AWS expertise through multi-cloud architecture work at NeoBotiQc and Solutions Will, including CI/CD pipeline design and deployment [3][4]. He has also implemented continuous evaluation frameworks and LLM guardrails as part of his RAG assistant project, with OpenTelemetry tracing and automated rollback mechanisms [5]. The role requires background in RPA and process automation, which Steve has delivered through hyperautomation platforms, though his sources do not explicitly detail RPA tool experience. Steve's fluency in both English and French aligns with the language requirements.
